pages.text: Conjures forth loyal $(l:summons/slime_servants)Slime Servant$() around you to do your bidding.

Casting with $(l:crafts/staff/wild_staff)Wild Staff$() summon more Slime Servants. Casting with $(l:crafts/staff/abyss_staff)Abyss Staff$() will summon Tropical Slimes, $(l:crafts/staff/nether_staff)Nether Staff$() will summon Magma Cubes, $(l:crafts/staff/necro_staff)Necro Staff$() will summon Crypt Slimes.
